picks.reasoning: BLG has much better players in nearly every role, and Bin alone outclasses anything MKOI can put in the top lane. In a Bo1, raw talent decides it, so I'm not buying any upset talk.

BLG pushes a far faster early game. Their jungle-led skirmishes take first drakes and herald before MKOI can settle into their slower, scaling setups, and in a best of one that early map control just snowballs.

BLG's champion pools run deeper across the map, and Knight can play any mid matchup, so MKOI can't ban him out of the draft. A best of 1 leaves room for an upset, but BLG's power picks and mid-jungle priority should carry this one.

BLG's domestic record and past international results are well above MKOI's, and LPL teams have historically beaten LEC sides more often than not. A best of 1 leaves room for an upset, so I lean BLG clearly but not all the way.

BLG's core has been through deep international runs together and plays with a calm, shared confidence. MKOI has heart and a hungry locker room, but in a single game I trust the team that already knows how to breathe together under pressure.
